ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 25% high-intensity (white/off-white) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity region across the central span and peduncle interface. High-intensity contiguous fields are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Each high-intensity field contains multiple internal low-intensity circular pixel clusters (spots).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a wide obtuse angle (~130-140 degrees) and moderate pixel-depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire margin; variations consist of jagged peaks with pixel-amplitudes increasing toward the distal tips, distinct from the smooth water-line interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping upward and outward from the central notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed circular and ring-shaped high-contrast clusters across the dark central regions; high-density of dark circular spots within the white distal fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (scratches) primarily visible on the lower-central dark regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of irregular high-intensity textured pixels (barnacle encrustation) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; extensive scarring across the entire fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced texture at lobe apexes indicating localized biological colonization.
